name: portfolio-interview
description: Interview a person and build a multilingual static portfolio with source-backed claims, responsive HTML and search metadata.

interface.longDescription: Collect a person's approved experience, work samples, photo and contact choices through short guided rounds. Prepare an English or Arabic portfolio from a structured profile, then build and validate a static website with the packaged Node.js generator when the host provides execution. Responsive browser screenshots require optional Playwright. On hosts without Node.js, provide the validated profile and exact local build instructions rather than claiming a site was generated.
capabilities: Source-backed portfolio copy and work samples
English and Arabic RTL portfolio pages
Static-site generation with Node.js when available
Copy, SEO and HTML checks with optional browser QA
defaultPrompt: Interview me and build a bilingual portfolio using my CV and approved work samples
Create an Arabic portfolio for my law practice using only details I confirm
Review my portfolio profile, then rebuild and check the static website
